description: Digital orthophotography dating back to 2005. Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF (COG), original GeoTIFF, ECW, MrSID. 5,000 ft tile grid; tile naming reflects lower-left coordinate.

downloadedVsReferenced.imageryTiles: REFERENCED ONLY — per-tile S3 URLs; not vendored. Offline tooling fetches only needed tiles.

limitations: Recent collections (2018+) cover northern/central tiers; southwestern counties (Posey) have earlier-vintage coverage.
sourceName: Indiana Statewide Digital Aerial Imagery Catalog
updateFrequency: 4-year cycle; counties in three tiers South to North (Tier 1 Central, Tier 2 Eastern, Tier 3 Western)
